name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: UI SDK Autocomplete styled as a field: free text with suggestions that filter as you type, matches marked, Clear and Trigger buttons with tooltips, async suggestions through useAsyncOptions, floating labels and FormField binding.
docs: `<Autocomplete items>` with `<AutocompleteControl>` (the field's box) around `AutocompleteInput`, `AutocompleteClear` and `AutocompleteTrigger`, then `<AutocompleteContent>` with `AutocompleteEmpty`, `AutocompleteStatus` and `AutocompleteList` (renders `items`, or your `AutocompleteItem`s with `AutocompleteItemText`, which marks the match). The value is the text: any text is valid, a suggestion only fills it in; use `Combobox` when the value must be an option. `autoHighlight`, `inlineComplete`, `openOnFocus`, `emptyItems` (recent searches) and `submitOnSelect` with `onSubmit` are UI SDK's. For a server, `useAsyncOptions(load, { debounce })` (re-exported here): pass its `items` and `status`, `filter={false}`, and `setQuery` in `onValueChange`. In a `Field` the label names the input and `labelPlacement="in"`/`"on"` float it; `FormField` binds the text. Clear and Trigger are named "Clear" and "Show suggestions", overridable with `aria-label`.
